title: Propagate ACP cancellation into GAWD missions
goal: Carry the live ACP turn cancellation token through the GAWD-backed mission runner and watched PlaneBus request so a running session/cancel reaches cooperative GAWD mission checkpoints.

results.boundary: Core ACP cancellation propagation only; no dependency, Commercial, Minijinja, harvest, release, or credential change

acceptance.cargo test --offline --locked -p susi --: 2 passed, 0 failed; susi-gawd-a2a 3342 lines under 3347 ceiling

results.gate: cargo fmt passed; cargo local-workflow check ran all 145 binaries but one parallel peer_channel_hub run flaked after 77.3s; host_only_privacy and peer_channel_hub each passed in isolated reruns, and lean_core_ceilings passed in isolation
limitations: The full shared six-lane check had one environment-sensitive peer-channel failure; no focused or isolated rerun reproduced it.
